Cricket Matches and Series Coverage Across Outlets

Multiple Indian media outlets have covered various international cricket matches and series. Coverage includes live scores, results, ball-by-ball commentary, highlights, and news for T20 series and Test matches involving teams like Hungary, Austria, Switzerland, Denmark, Bangladesh, Zimbabwe, Serbia, Czechia, Luxembourg, New Zealand, and others. The reports focus on specific match details and upcoming fixtures.

How outlets across the spectrum covered it

  • Left (3): National Herald, The Hindu, The Telegraph (India)
  • Centre (16): Amar Ujala, Deccan Chronicle, Deccan Herald, Greater Kashmir, Hindustan (Hindi) · Hindustan Times (HT Media — 1 vote), Jansatta · The Indian Express (Indian Express Group — 1 vote), Mathrubhumi English, Navbharat Times · The Times of India (Times Group — 1 vote), Patrika, Telangana Today, The Free Press Journal, The Lallantop, The Print
  • Right (8): Aaj Tak · India Today (India Today Group — 1 vote), Dainik Jagran, Firstpost · News18 Hindi (Network18 — 1 vote), Republic World, The Pioneer, Zee News (Hindi)
  • International (4): Al Jazeera English, Associated Press, France 24, Reuters
